'''Derah din Selaan Rising Wave''' is of the [[Sea Folk]] and is [[Sailmistress]] of the ''[[White Spray]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She is short and in her middle years. She has four earrings in each ear.

== Activities ==
She is present when [[Harine din Togara Two Winds]] makes the Bargain with [[Rand al'Thor]], their ''[[Coramoor]]''.

She goes with Harine to [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] to demand for Harine's sister [[Shalon din Togara Morning Tide]]. She is sent away empty handed.
